name: Argent
source:
"That's not something I can discuss with you quite yet, I'm affraid. It's a closely guarded secret."

Argent is an eccentric lord with a surprisingly gentle demeanor. As a leader of a secret society, he has a number of secrets, some og wich he may share with the right person.

[From [url=https://saelinstudios.itch.io/the-secret-society]itch.io[/url]]
